tasks.mutation_description: Incorrect atomic nesting: django/db/transaction.py Atomic.__enter__ always creates savepoint instead of checking in_atomic_block
tasks.public_task_prompt: In the Django repository at c6be0bf, transaction handling for nested atomic blocks is broken. When using `with transaction.atomic():` inside an already atomic block, the inner block should reuse the outer transaction without creating a new savepoint, but currently it always creates a savepoint. Fix the implementation so nested atomic correctly handles the in_atomic_block case. Verify with the transaction tests. If repository-intelligence tools are available in this environment, you may use them when useful.
